overview_description.description: Jasper is an AI platform specifically designed for marketing, enabling users to generate high-quality content at a significantly faster rate. It automates various marketing processes and enhances brand experience. The company provides tools for creating a wide range of content, including blog posts, social media updates, and marketing copy, leveraging advanced AI technology. It features a text-to-image generator that allows users to create visually appealing, on-brand images based on textual descriptions.

about_short_description.short_description: Jasper is an AI platform specifically designed for marketing, enabling users to generate high-quality content.

product.name: Jasper Platform
product.description: A cloud-based AI workspace for marketing teams that combines specialized agents, governed context, workflow automation, and content production across marketing channels.

product.name: Jasper Agents
product.description: Purpose-built AI agents that execute marketing tasks and end-to-end workflows, including SEO, AI-search optimization, research, translation, campaign execution, email, social media, and personalization.

product.name: Jasper IQ
product.description: A governed context and intelligence layer that applies brand voice, style guides, audience profiles, product knowledge, visual rules, and governance policies to generated marketing assets.

product.name: Jasper Content Pipelines
product.description: A structured workflow system for converting marketing plans and briefs into repeatable, multi-step content production and campaign processes.

product.name: GEO & AI Optimization
product.description: A marketing optimization offering that measures brand visibility in AI answer engines, identifies content gaps, and supports the creation of content designed for AI citation.

product.name: Jasper Image Pipelines
product.description: Automated workflows for generating and scaling on-brand product imagery and other visual marketing assets for enterprise use.
